title: Comms Systems — Multi-Band Communication Routing
description: Communication link selection and security validation for wearable systems. 7 link types across 4 domains (BLE/Wi-Fi 6E/5G/LoRa/Iridium/VHF/ADS-B). Security gate validates mTLS, firmware signature, replay protection, and certificate pinning before transmission.

tools.name: route-comms-link
tools.description: Route communication to optimal link based on range, data rate, criticality, and link availability. 7 link types: BLE (controller), Wi-Fi 6E (ground station), 5G (cloud), LoRa (telemetry fallback), Iridium Certus (satcom), VHF radio (ATC), ADS-B Out (position broadcast).

parameters.name: data_rate_required
parameters.description: Required throughput: telemetry_only, low_bandwidth, medium_bandwidth, high_bandwidth, video

parameters.name: criticality
parameters.description: Message criticality: routine, priority, emergency, atc_mandatory

parameters.name: airborne
parameters.description: Whether the suit is currently in flight

parameters.name: wifi_available
parameters.description: Whether Wi-Fi 6E ground station is in range

tools.name: check-comms-security
tools.description: Validate communication security posture before transmitting. Gates on mTLS, firmware signature, replay protection, and certificate pinning. Blocks transmission if security requirements unmet. VHF/ADS-B always pass (unencrypted by aviation regulation).

parameters.name: link_type
parameters.description: Link type: ble_5, wifi_6e, fiveg_modem, lora_sx1276, iridium_certus, vhf_radio, adsb_out

parameters.name: firmware_signed
parameters.description: Whether modem firmware signature verified at boot

parameters.name: replay_nonce_valid
parameters.description: Whether replay protection nonce counter is current

parameters.name: certificate_pinned
parameters.description: Whether TLS certificate is pinned to known CA
